# GroundFall-US: summary of results

*Version 1.0. Generated by code/08_summary.py from paper/stats.json; do not edit by hand.*

## The dataset

- **29,851** ground-failure records at U.S. mines, 2000 to 2026 (2026 partial), selected by MSHA classification "fall of roof or back" or "fall of face/rib/pillar/side/highwall".
- Of these, **9,465** injured someone (MSHA degrees 01 to 06), **162** were fatal, and **20,327** were reportable falls in which nobody was hurt.
- **100.0%** of records matched the MSHA Mines file and **99.65%** matched hours worked for the same mine, subunit, and year.

## Injury rates per 200,000 hours (mine-operator employees, contractors excluded)

| Sector and mine type | Injuries 2000-2025 | Deaths 2000-2025 | Rate 2000 | Rate 2025 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Coal, underground | 7,742 | 103 | 1.180 | 0.376 |
| Coal, surface | 68 | 11 | 0.006 | 0.012 |
| Metal/nonmetal, underground | 831 | 26 | 0.617 | 0.126 |
| Metal/nonmetal, surface | 66 | 8 | 0.006 | 0.000 |
